appraisal_events.evidence: Mme Sazerat se contenta d'un salut glacé, forcé par la politesse envers quelqu'un qui est coupable d'une mauvaise action...Dès qu'elle le sut antidreyfusard, elle mit entre elle et lui des continents et des siècles.
appraisal_events.explanation: On learning that the narrator's parents are anti-Dreyfusard, the longtime family friend Mme Sazerat coldly cuts them both -- an icy bow to the father and, the next day, a handshake withheld from the mother -- deliberately severing a relation of long standing.

appraisal_events.evidence: Il ne me reparla pas de huit jours quand il apprit que j'avais suivi une ligne de conduite différente.
appraisal_events.explanation: The father punishes the narrator with a week of silence upon learning he had taken the opposing (Dreyfusard) position, withholding normal relation as a mark of displeasure.

status_effects.explanation: Mme Sazerat deliberately and visibly severs her long social relation with the father, placing him definitively outside her circle of regard.
He is now viewed by Mme Sazerat, and not far from being labeled a nationalist by others, as complicit in a collective injustice.
Mme Sazerat withholds her hand and offers only a distant, sad smile, extending the same social rupture to the mother despite her innocence of the political rift.
The father's week-long silence exerts emotional pressure on the narrator for having diverged from the family's political stance.
